note: Approximate typical residential (domestic) electricity rates by state/UT, in rupees per unit (kWh), for a household using roughly 300-500 units a month. 'rate' blends the slabs that household passes through and is rounded to one decimal; 'range' is the low and high slab rate it touches. Unless 'includes' says otherwise, the figure is the energy charge only: fixed charges, electricity duty, and monthly fuel/power-purchase surcharges are excluded. Where a large per-unit add-on is part of almost every bill (Gujarat FPPPA, Delhi PPAC and surcharges, Maharashtra wheeling), it is folded in and 'includes' says so. Figures come from FY2025-26 tariff orders, or FY2026-27 where a newer order was found, taken mainly from news reports on the orders and from tariff aggregators. Rates differ by DISCOM, load, urban/rural category and subsidy eligibility, and state free-unit schemes can lower an actual bill a lot. Use these numbers only as a rough estimate when the visitor does not know their own rate. Gathered 2026-10-28.

Andaman & Nicobar.includes: Energy charge only; fixed charge and duty excluded.
Andaman & Nicobar.as_of: JERC MYT order FY2025-26 to FY2029-30 (effective 1 Nov 2025); slabs from an aggregator, not confirmed against the order

Andhra Pradesh.includes: Energy charge only on the single telescopic domestic schedule (0-30 1.90, 31-75 3.00, 76-125 4.50, 126-225 6.00, 226-400 8.75, >400 9.75); true-up/FPPCA (about 0.4/unit), fixed charge and duty excluded.
Andhra Pradesh.as_of: APERC RST order FY2025-26 (no hike; kept for FY2026-27); slab values from the earlier unchanged schedule

Arunachal Pradesh.includes: Energy charge only; roughly a flat domestic rate.

Assam.includes: Energy charge only for Domestic-B (1-120 5.99, 121-240 6.99, >240 7.94), after AERC's Re 1/unit cut from 1 Apr 2025; fixed charge, duty and FPPPA excluded.
Assam.as_of: AERC order FY2025-26 (unchanged for FY2026-27); slab values from an aggregator

Bihar.includes: Effective urban domestic rate after state subsidy (base tariff 7.42/unit minus about 3.30 subsidy). Range shows subsidised vs unsubsidised. Since Aug 2025 the first 125 units a month are free, so a bill is lower than this rate suggests. Fixed charge and duty excluded.
Bihar.as_of: BERC FY2025-26 / FY2026-27 (merged single slab at 7.42 base)

Chandigarh.discom: Chandigarh Power Distribution Ltd (CPDL, private licensee since 2025)
Chandigarh.includes: Energy charge only; fixed charge and duty excluded. Only the 1-100 slab (2.80) is confirmed; the higher slabs are estimated.
Chandigarh.as_of: JERC order FY2025-26 (new rates from 1 Nov 2025)

Chhattisgarh.includes: Energy charge only (FY2026-27 0-100 4.40, 101-200 about 4.50, 201-400 about 6.0); VCA surcharge, fixed charge and duty excluded. A household above 200 units does not get the half-bill subsidy.
Chhattisgarh.as_of: CSERC FY2026-27 schedule (FY2025-26 0-100 4.10, 101-200 4.20); higher slabs estimated

Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.discom: DNH & DD Power Distribution Corporation (Torrent Power)
Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.includes: Energy charge only; fixed charge (about 15/kW) and 8% duty excluded.

Delhi (NCT).discom: BSES Rajdhani / BSES Yamuna / Tata Power-DDL (same DERC schedule)
Delhi (NCT).includes: Energy charge (0-200 3.00, 201-400 4.50, 401-800 6.50) plus about 30% for PPAC (about 15-18%), the 8% regulatory surcharge and the pension surcharge. Fixed charge excluded. Range is base energy charge. The state subsidy only covers households up to 400 units.
Delhi (NCT).as_of: DERC tariff schedule in force FY2025-26 (no new order); PPAC levels mid-2026

Goa.includes: Energy charge only (1-100 1.96, 101-200 2.91, 201-300 3.89, 301-400 about 4.9, >400 5.40); fixed charge, FPPCA and duty excluded.
Goa.as_of: JERC MYT order FY2025-26 (effective 1 Nov 2025); slab values from an aggregator

Gujarat.includes: Energy charge (RGP 0-50 3.05, 51-100 3.50, 101-250 4.15, >250 5.20) plus FPPPA of about 2.85/unit, which is on every bill. Fixed charge and duty excluded.
Gujarat.as_of: GERC order FY2025-26 (no change to RGP energy charges); FPPPA level approximate

Haryana.includes: Energy charge only for Category II (0-150 2.95, 151-300 about 5.25, 301-500 about 6.45). Fixed charge, FSA and duty excluded. Above 500 units a household moves to a non-telescopic category at 6.50-7.50.

Himachal Pradesh.includes: Energy charge only (0-125 5.45, above 125 5.90, unsubsidised). Fixed charge, cesses and a fuel surcharge of about 0.34 from 2026 excluded. Households above 300 units lose the state subsidy.
Himachal Pradesh.as_of: HPERC order FY2025-26 (FY2026-27 cut by 1 paisa)

Jammu & Kashmir.includes: Subsidised metered domestic rate actually billed (up to 200 2.45, 201-400 4.20, above 400 4.60 after the 6.83% hike; earlier 2.30/4.00/4.35). Fixed charge and duty excluded.

Jharkhand.includes: Energy charge only, at a flat urban domestic rate (6.85 in FY2025-26, 7.40 in FY2026-27). Fixed charge excluded. The state free-power scheme only covers households up to 200 units.

Karnataka.discom: BESCOM (also MESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, CESC Mysuru; same schedule)
Karnataka.includes: Flat domestic energy charge of about 5.80, plus the pension surcharge of about 0.36 and the true-up of about 0.56 from May 2026. Fixed charge (about 145/kW) and 9% tax excluded. Gruha Jyothi free power only covers households up to about 200 units.
Karnataka.as_of: KERC MYT order FY2025-26 to FY2027-28 (plus 2026 true-up)

Kerala.includes: Energy charge only. Above 250 units a month all units are billed at one non-telescopic slab rate (0-300 about 6.7, 0-400 about 7.7, 0-500 about 7.9, above 500 about 9.3). Billing is bimonthly. Fixed charge, fuel surcharge and duty excluded.
Kerala.as_of: KSERC order Dec 2024 covering FY2025-26 (+12 paise); upper slabs estimated

Ladakh.includes: Energy charge only (201-400 3.80, above 400 4.20; the 0-200 slab is estimated). Fixed charge excluded.
Ladakh.as_of: Existing rates shown in the JERC petition for FY2025-26 (petition, not the final order)

Lakshadweep.includes: Energy charge only; fixed charge excluded. Estimated from the JERC structure for small UTs.

Madhya Pradesh.includes: Energy charge only (about 0-50 4.65, 51-150 5.65, 151-300 7.10, above 300 7.30, after the 4.8% FY2026-27 hike). Fixed charge, FCA and duty excluded.
Madhya Pradesh.as_of: MPERC FY2026-27 (estimated by scaling FY2025-26 slabs)

Maharashtra.includes: Energy charge (0-100 4.08, 101-300 7.39, above 300 10.26) plus the wheeling charge of about 1.45/unit. Fixed charge, FAC and duty excluded. A March 2026 fresh MERC order announced further relief that may lower this by about 5-10%.
Maharashtra.as_of: MERC revised order FY2025-26 (from 1 Jul 2025); Mumbai licensee rates are estimates

Odisha.discom: TP Central / Western / Northern / Southern Odisha Distribution (Tata Power)
Odisha.includes: Energy charge only (0-50 2.90, 51-200 4.70, 201-400 5.70, above 400 6.10). Fixed charge, duty and the digital-payment rebate excluded.

Puducherry.includes: Energy charge actually billed, after the state subsidy on the 101-200 slab (about 2.7 / 3.6 / 6.0 / 7.5). Fixed charge, FPPCA and duty excluded.

Punjab.includes: Energy charge only on the two-slab schedule (0-300 about 5.40, above 300 about 7.75 per kVAh). The 300 free units a month apply only while consumption stays within the limit, so a household above it is billed for all units at these rates. Fixed charge and duty excluded.

Rajasthan.includes: Energy charge (0-50 4.75, 51-150 6.00, 151-300 about 7.00, 301-500 about 7.30) plus the 1/unit regulatory surcharge introduced in FY2025-26. Fixed charge, fuel surcharge and duty excluded.

Sikkim.includes: Energy charge only; estimate. Sikkim has some of India's lowest domestic tariffs.

Tamil Nadu.includes: Energy charge only, net of the first 100 units free, on bimonthly slabs (101-400 4.80, 401-500 6.45, 501-600 8.55, 601-800 9.65, 801-1000 10.70) for 600-1000 units per two months. The government absorbed the July 2025 hike for domestic consumers. Fixed charge excluded.

Telangana.includes: Energy charge only for households above 200 units (0-200 5.10, 201-300 7.70, 301-400 9.00, 401-800 9.50). Fixed charge and duty excluded. Gruha Jyothi free power only covers households up to 200 units.

Tripura.includes: Energy charge only; estimate anchored on the FY2025-26 average cost of supply (7.61).

Uttar Pradesh.discom: UPPCL discoms (PVVNL, MVVNL, DVVNL, PuVVNL, KESCo)
Uttar Pradesh.includes: Energy charge only for urban domestic (0-150 5.50, 151-300 6.00, 301-500 6.50, above 500 7.00). Fixed charge and 5% duty excluded.
Uttar Pradesh.as_of: UPERC order FY2025-26 (unchanged for 6th year; NPCL keeps 10% regulatory rebate)

Uttarakhand.includes: Energy charge only (0-100 3.65, 101-200 5.25, 201-400 7.15, above 400 7.80). Fixed charge, FPPCA and duty excluded.

West Bengal.includes: Energy charge only, on quarterly slabs (1-102 5.26, 103-180 6.23, 181-300 6.95, 301-600 7.30, higher up to about 8.0) for 900-1500 units a quarter. Fixed charge and duty excluded.
West Bengal.as_of: WBERC MYT FY2023-24 to FY2025-26 (aggregator slab values)
